caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a brown top surface and sides colored in a pale yellow or cream shade. The front panel of the chest is decorated with three large, similarly-sized arched sections, each featuring detailed floral patterns in red, green, and touches of blue. Two red star motifs are present in the arched upper portions at each end, while the central arch has a blue and white shield-like shape at the top. The three main sections on the front are separated by vertical bands, adorned with a repeating red and green floral or leaf pattern. The chest has a molded base and curved bracket feet, also in yellow, with some shading to indicate depth and dimension. The handles on the sides are metallic and depicted in a dull gray or blue hue. The design of the chest is symmetrical, and the overall composition is rendered in colored pencil on off-white or lightly aged paper, with outlines and shadowing providing additional definition to the structure.
title: Pa. German Chest
